agent_explanation: Single fast body in free flight (no walls, no controller, no collisions) gains total energy every step. vx is constant but vy drops by ~1.836 per dt=0.0312 step while g*dt predicts only ~0.306 (6x too much); positions advance correctly by v*dt, so the gravity velocity update over-applies. The excess kinetic energy outweighs the potential drop, producing monotonic energy growth from 6860.79 to 7551.94 and breaching energy_bound at step 4.
